description: Data type 'x500Name' holds an X.500 distinguished name in the string form of RFC 4514 (RFC 2253 forms are also read). Text read as an x500Name must parse as a distinguished name; other text is an error. The text is kept as written. Two x500Name values are equal when each of their RDNs is the same: attribute types ignore case and a type's name equals its OID ("cn" is "2.5.4.3"), values ignore case and leading, trailing, and repeated spaces, and the parts of a multi-valued RDN may be in any order. So "cn=A,o=B"x500Name equals "CN=a, O=b"x500Name. It has no ordering. Use x500Name_match() to check that a name ends with the RDNs of another. In a script, write one as a typed literal: "cn=a,o=b"x500Name or "cn=a,o=b"dn.
